name: verne-french-editions
description: Real public-domain French-language edition pair (BACKLOG B4 / tokeniser parity B6): the opening paragraph of Jules Verne's 'Vingt mille lieues sous les mers' (Part 1, Ch.1) in two independent French Project Gutenberg editions. Same-language, same-author edition variation — the two transcriptions differ only by an accidental (a comma at 'continents, les gens' present in one edition, absent in the other). Its value is exercising the tokeniser on FRENCH: accented characters (é, à, È) and elision apostrophes (L'année, n'a, l'esprit, l'intérieur, l'Europe) — the cross-script/parity concern of B6. See docs/development/CASE_STUDY.md.
